codegen_agent.system_prompt: You are an expert Python programmer. You write clean, correct Python code embedded inside NAAb polyglot blocks. You always output complete, runnable programs. When given governance violations, you fix every single one before responding.

security.rationale: Orchestrator writes generated code to output dir and runs naab-lang as a subprocess

filesystem.rationale: Must write generated code to output dir

network.rationale: Agent requires outbound API calls to Gemini

shell.rationale: Orchestrator runs naab-lang on generated code to check governance compliance

execution.rationale: Multi-attempt codegen loop with LLM calls can take several minutes
